description: A hybrid planning application for:Detailed planning application for works to including:The erection of a deck structure, linked staircase and pedestrian and cyclist lift at Mackenzie Walk, the erection of a new pedestrian and cyclist lift adjacent to the Newfoundland Place Tower fronting Westferry Road. Partial demolition (levels 1 and 2) and associated external alterations to the existing Newfoundland Annex Building, minor alterations to the Newfoundland Place Tower, and associated works.Outline planning application (landscaping, appearance, layout matters reserved) for:Details of appearance in relation to the public realm, landscaping and details relating to the hard/soft landscaping works on and around the deck and the layout of pedestrian access routes, circulation areas and associated surface arrangements; and other works associated with the development.[For consultation only: Application 0]
site_name: Land at Westferry Road, Mackenzie Walk  and parts of the ground, first and second floors of Newfoundland Place Tower and Annex.
